request: 把ssh tcp udp的插件功能合并到terminal里面，还有串口通信
acceptance: Terminal includes all 35 existing SSH/TCP/UDP/serial tools under collision-free terminal_ names
TCP client/server, UDP and serial sessions share workbench navigation, bounded TX/RX logs and explicit text/hex sending
Preserve SSH workspace, password/reference-key behavior; isolate communication resources by workspace, stop on daemon shutdown
Exercise real loopback TCP/UDP, virtual serial, SSH/SFTP/tunnel and browser UI; publish documented package with verified runtime dependencies
scope: Aide Terminal mirror, scoped daemon context and integration tests
Terminal market release and handoff docs

requirements.summary: Merge full implemented tool set, not just connection declarations; retain old packages for compatibility.

design.summary: Per-workspace communication instances, prefixed legacy operations, shared basic sessions, pinned dependencies, canonical tool policy checks.

implementation.summary: Merged all35 SSH/TCP/UDP/serial operations;49 tools total. TCP client/listener, UDP and serial workbench, explicit UTF8/HEX send and bounded TX/RX logs. Compatibility markers and no fallback on old host.

verification.summary: All focused checks pass; full running-host UI remains NOT_RUN because start.command activation prerequisites are unresolved. No formal host image release.

documentation.summary: README, changelog, module attribution and host protocol cover tools, dependencies, transfer roots, permissions, execution location and hardware limitations.

cleanup.summary: Scoped diffs reviewed; original plugins/archives retained, npm development assets excluded from ZIP, preexisting task files and live services preserved.

release.summary: Host main a568a538 and Terminal1.3.1 badf9ac/tag pushed; public prerelease published. Market c5c421a deployed successfully; anonymous release ZIP/SHA256SUMS and actual live market ZIP, source and capability flag verified. Source1.3.0/archive preserved; no formal Aide image release.

release_authorization: Current merge request continues active Terminal push/release/market workflow; direct main push authorized earlier.
rollback: Restore prior immutable plugin ZIP and matching host code. Upgrade ends running sessions/connections; workbench logs/records remain. No running service or user data replaced.
handoff: Requires matching Aide main. Existing comm-* packages retained. Physical serial device mapping/permissions must be configured in the Aide runtime; virtual devices only validated here.

intermediate_tag.status: Retained source tag/archive, superseded by 1.3.1 before GitHub Release/market publication to fix RTS/CTS mapping.

delivery.fullStartCommandUI: NOT_RUN; existing activation blocker recorded, no bypass launcher used
